scripts.text:
[Meera]
Welcome to Geffen,
the City of Magic!
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
欢迎来到吉芬，魔法之城！

scripts.text:
[Meera]
I don't know much about magic, but do you know what tastes magical? ^CC6600Honey^000000!
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
我对魔法了解不多，但你知道什么尝起来有魔法的味道吗？^CC6600蜂蜜^000000！

scripts.text:
[Meera]
It's soooo sweet and delicious. I'm not sure if it's an aphrodisiac, but I know for a fact that it will relieve you of fatigue and help you recover from wounds!
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
它超级甜美可口。我不确定它是不是春药，但我可以肯定的是，它能消除你的疲劳并帮助你从伤痛中恢复！

scripts.text:
[Meera]
Hornets living in the grasslands spend their lives gathering nectar at the Queen Bee's command. Honey is made from the nectar they gather.
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
生活在草原上的蜂兵在蜂后的命令下花费一生采集花蜜。蜂蜜就是由它们采集的花蜜制成的。

scripts.text:
[Meera]
But that's not all. There's a special kind of honey that's made for only Queen Bees to eat:
^CC6600Royal Jelly^000000!
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
但这还不是全部。有一种特殊的蜂蜜是专门为蜂后食用的：
^CC6600蜂胶^000000！

scripts.text:
[Meera]
Nothing can compare to the luscious flavor of Royal Jelly. And I think it's even better for you than ordinary Honey!
scripts.translation:
[米拉]
没有什么能比得上蜂胶那浓郁的风味。而且我认为它比普通蜂蜜对你更有益！

scripts.text:
[Orwalk]
...Interesting.
Most intriguing.
Oh! Let me tell you
this marvelous story~
scripts.translation:
[奥沃克]
……有趣。
非常引人入胜。
哦！让我给你讲讲
这个精彩的故事~

scripts.text:
[Orwalk]
While I was researching magic, I discovered this mysterious scroll. It describes this tree named Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[奥沃克]
在我研究魔法时，我发现了这卷神秘的卷轴。它描述了一棵名为尤克特拉希尔的树。

scripts.text:
[Orwalk]
The leaves, seeds and fruit of Yggdrasil link every living thing in this world. According to this scroll, Yggdrasil is also involved in the creation of the world.
scripts.translation:
[奥沃克]
尤克特拉希尔的叶子、种子和果实将这个世界上的每一个生命联系在一起。根据这卷卷轴，尤克特拉希尔也参与了世界的创造。

scripts.text:
[Orwalk]
Speaking of which, I've also heard of a rumor about a miraculous tree in some land near Comodo. They must be connected, I'm sure of it!
scripts.translation:
[奥沃克]
说到这个，我也听说过在克魔岛附近的某个地方有一棵奇迹之树的传闻。它们肯定是有联系的，我敢肯定！

scripts.text:
[Stanza]
I sense the presence of a mighty spirit. Can it be you...?
scripts.translation:
[斯坦扎]
我感觉到一股强大的灵魂气息。难道是你……？

scripts.text:
[Stanza]
It seems that you are trained in the mystic arts. Magic... Its power is governed by the law of cause and effect.
scripts.translation:
[斯坦扎]
看来你受过神秘艺术的训练。魔法……它的力量受因果律的支配。

scripts.text:
[Stanza]
Ah...
I see that you wield holy power in one way or another. I suppose Holy power may be considered one form of mystical energy.
scripts.translation:
[斯坦扎]
啊……
我看你以某种方式掌握着神圣的力量。我想神圣力量也可以被视为一种神秘能量。

scripts.text:
[Stanza]
Although you may not be able to use magic or any other kind of powerful skills for now, this knowledge may be helpful in the future, young Novice...
scripts.translation:
[斯坦扎]
虽然你现在可能无法使用魔法或其他任何强大的技能，但这些知识在未来可能会有所帮助，年轻的初心者……

scripts.text:
[Stanza]
Although you are not formally trained in the use of magic, you use skills which draw upon otherworldly energies, whether you know it or not...
scripts.translation:
[斯坦扎]
虽然你没有接受过正式的魔法训练，但你使用的技能汲取了异界的能量，无论你是否意识到这一点……

scripts.text:
[Stanza]
If you use mystic energy for the purpose of harming others, or to defy the rules set by Mother Nature, that power will naturally be turned against you. Remember, you reap what you sow.
scripts.translation:
[斯坦扎]
如果你使用神秘能量来伤害他人，或者违背自然母亲设定的规则，那么这股力量自然会反过来对付你。记住，种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆。

scripts.text:
[Stanza]
But there is an item that can protect the caster from ill consequence, allowing the safe use of certain magics. These are the shining, mystical stones known as Gemstones.
scripts.translation:
[斯坦扎]
但是有一种物品可以保护施法者免受不良后果，从而安全地使用某些魔法。这些闪闪发光的神秘石头被称为宝石原石。

scripts.text:
[Stanza]
Gemstone...
If you wish to use your powers to the fullest, remember this item.
scripts.translation:
[斯坦扎]
宝石原石……
如果你想充分发挥你的力量，请记住这件物品。

scripts.text:
[Ralphie]
Somewhere in this world, there is a rare Staff which can transform psychic energy into physical force, endowing its owner with ^990000destructive power^000000...
scripts.translation:
[拉尔菲]
在这个世界的某个地方，有一根罕见的法杖，可以将精神能量转化为物理力量，赋予其主人^990000毁灭性的力量^000000……

scripts.text:
[Ralphie]
With that, anyone could be as strong as Hercules... Even a weakling like me! Hahahahahah,
I must have it!
scripts.translation:
[拉尔菲]
有了它，任何人都可以像赫拉克勒斯一样强大……即使是像我这样的弱者！哈哈哈哈哈哈，
我必须得到它！

scripts.text:
[Ralphie]
...Good Heavens!
Since when were
you listening?
scripts.translation:
[拉尔菲]
……天哪！
你从什么时候开始
在听的？

scripts.text:
[Ralphie]
Did you happen
to hear any of that?
Muhwaha... ha. Ha.
scripts.translation:
[拉尔菲]
你碰巧
听到了什么吗？
唔哇哈……哈。哈。

scripts.text:
[Ralphie]
Well...
I didn't say anything. But if
I did, forget all about it,
whatever it was~
scripts.translation:
[拉尔菲]
嗯……
我什么都没说。但如果
我说了，忘掉这一切，
不管是什么~

scripts.text:
[Ralphie]
...Boy, this is awkward.
scripts.translation:
[拉尔菲]
……哎呀，真尴尬。

scripts.text:
[Stacey]
Oh...!
Is that an Orc Helm you're wearing?! That's so cool! Wow...
scripts.translation:
[史黛西]
哦……！
你戴的是兽人头盔吗？！太酷了！哇……

scripts.text:
[Stacey]
You look so...
Rugged and manly~
scripts.translation:
[史黛西]
你看起来好……
粗犷又有男子气概~

scripts.text:
[Stacey]
Oooh~!
I'm so jealous!
scripts.translation:
[史黛西]
噢~！
我好嫉妒！

scripts.text:
[Stacey]
Oh...
Wow...
scripts.translation:
[史黛西]
哦……
哇……

scripts.text:
[Stacey]
That's...
That's a Helmet
of Orc Hero!
scripts.translation:
[史黛西]
那是……
那是兽人英雄的头盔！

scripts.text:
[Stacey]
It's...
It's like you're surrounded by this incredibly masculine aura! Oooh~! You must be irresistible to all the girls!
scripts.translation:
[史黛西]
这……
就像你被一种极其阳刚的气场所包围！噢~！你对所有女孩来说一定难以抗拒！

scripts.text:
[Stacey]
Goodness, you must be so strong!
But I thought only members of the Orc Tribe could wear those?
scripts.translation:
[史黛西]
天哪，你一定很强壮！
但我以为只有兽人部落的成员才能戴那些？

scripts.text:
[Stacey]
And I'm no exception.
scripts.translation:
[史黛西]
我也不例外。

scripts.text:
[Stacey]
Hello~!
Oh, aren't you
an adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[史黛西]
你好~！
哦，你不是
冒险者吗？

scripts.text:
[Stacey]
Have you ever seen any Orcs from the Demi-Human tribe? If you go down southward from here, I think you can find Orcs in the deep forest.
scripts.translation:
[史黛西]
你见过半人种族群的兽人吗？如果你从这里向南走，我想你可以在森林深处找到兽人。

scripts.text:
[Stacey]
I hear that Orcs have their own culture and language, supposedly just like us humans. Does that mean Orcs go on dates...?
scripts.translation:
[史黛西]
我听说兽人有自己的文化和语言，据说就像我们人类一样。这意味着兽人也会约会……？

scripts.text:
[Stacey]
You know, where they tenderly whisper sweet nothings and then... Oh! I really want to know!
scripts.translation:
[史黛西]
你知道，他们会温柔地耳语甜言蜜语，然后……哦！我真的很想知道！

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
Hello!
Isn't it a
wonderful
day today?
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
你好！
今天不是个
美好的
日子吗？

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
Well, I wouldn't know. I've been studying too hard to become a Mage. I've been staying up all night, agonizing over anything that's magical.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
嗯，我不知道。我一直努力学习想成为魔法师。我整晚熬夜，为任何与魔法有关的事情而苦恼。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
*Sigh...*
I especially worry about all the drawbacks to using magic.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
*叹气……*
我特别担心使用魔法的所有缺点。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
Oh darn! It was really annoying when a long-ranged enemy found me the last time I went exploring. That crummy monster disrupted the casting of all my spells! I didn't hit it at all!
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
哦，该死！上次我去探险时，一个远程敌人发现了我，真的很烦人。那个糟糕的魔物打断了我所有咒语的吟唱！我根本没打中它！

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
After that, I realized I needed some sort of weapon to counter long-ranged attacks from enemies. Something that can attack from a distance...
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
在那之后，我意识到我需要某种武器来对抗敌人的远程攻击。某种可以从远处攻击的东西……

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
Some sort of...
Sharp, piercing
projectile launcher, preferably made out of wood.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
某种……
尖锐、穿透性的
投射器，最好是用木头做的。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
But where could
I find something
like that?!
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
但是我在哪里
能找到那样的
东西呢？！

scripts.text:
[?]
^333333*Psssst!*
H-Hey you!
You wanna get your hands on some great stuff? Come on over!^000000
scripts.translation:
[?]
^333333*嘘！*
嘿-嘿你！
你想弄到一些好东西吗？过来吧！^000000

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Hey there tough guy. You look smart enough to recognize a bargain when it's right in front of your eyes.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
嘿，硬汉。你看起来够聪明，能在 bargain 摆在眼前时认出来。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Well, well, well. Aren't you a pretty girl. Today just happens to be your lucky day!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
好吧，好吧，好吧。你不是个漂亮的女孩吗。今天正好是你的幸运日！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
So just tell me what you want, and I'll cut you a deal from amongst my valuable, yet affordable, wares.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
所以只要告诉我你想要什么，我就会从我珍贵但负担得起的商品中给你打个折。

scripts.text: Gimme some potion so I can recover HP.
scripts.translation: 给我一些药水让我恢复HP。

scripts.text: Um, you got a Knife?
scripts.translation: 嗯，你有短剑吗？

scripts.text: Don't you have a good Manteau?
scripts.translation: 你没有好的披风吗？

scripts.text: Don't you have something besides this?
scripts.translation: 除了这个你没有别的了吗？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Ah, you into Potions, eh?
Yeah, I got the stuff!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
啊，你喜欢药水，是吗？
是的，我有货！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Here it is! High quality Red Potion! It starts working right away once you take it. Once it hits your lips, you can't stop. This stuff is that good.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
在这里！高品质的红色药水！一旦服用就会立即生效。一旦沾上嘴唇，你就停不下来。这东西就是那么好。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
C'mon dude. This is the latest Red Potion. I got it from a close friend of a friend, you know, a real dependable source, and it's real cheap too. You can't pass this up!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
来吧伙计。这是最新的红色药水。我是从一个朋友的朋友那里得到的，你知道，一个真正可靠的来源，而且真的很便宜。你不能错过这个！

scripts.text: Uh, can I buy White Potions instead?
scripts.translation: 呃，我可以买白色药水吗？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
White Potions? Oh, those don't exist. But, er, if someone's selling that kind of stuff, bring it to me so I can, um, test the difference. But yeah, I got the real stuff.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
白色药水？哦，那些不存在。但是，呃，如果有人在卖那种东西，把它带给我，这样我就可以，嗯，测试一下区别。但是是的，我有真货。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
You can heal all your wounds by drinking Red Potions! And I'll sell you one for just ^FF3333500 zeny^000000!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
你可以通过喝红色药水治愈所有的伤口！而且我只卖你一个^FF3333500泽尼^000000！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Now, how cheap is that?! Since they're in such high demand, I can only sell you 100 of
them at a time.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
现在，这有多便宜？！由于需求量大，我一次只能卖给你100个。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Ah duuuuuude~ You're breakin' my heart! I mean, at these prices, I'm practically performing charity!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
啊兄弟~你伤透了我的心！我的意思是，以这些价格，我简直是在做慈善！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
W-waaaait! You didn't let me tell you the part about how Red Potions help you lose and gain weight in all the right places! Waaaaait!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
等-等等！你还没让我告诉你红色药水如何帮助你在正确的地方减肥和增重！等等！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Whoa...
I can't let you buy that many. I mean, it's not like, you know, there's a trace impurity in these Potions or anything like that...
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
哇……
我不能让你买那么多。我的意思是，这并不是说，你知道，这些药水里有什么微量杂质之类的……

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Oh maaan~
Are you
short on dough?
That's no good.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
哦天哪~
你是
缺钱吗？
那不好。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
^333333Now I gotta find some other sucker to dump this junk on!^000000 *Ahem* I mean, come again!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
^333333现在我得找其他倒霉蛋来处理这些垃圾了！^000000 *咳咳* 我的意思是，欢迎再来！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
What would a strong guy like you want a knife for? Those will just break under the force of your incredibly powerful swings!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
像你这样强壮的人要短剑做什么？那些会在你极其强大的挥击力量下断裂！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
A nice lady like you? Come on now, kitchen knives are for old naggy wives and the hired help.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
像你这样漂亮的女士？拜托，菜刀是给唠叨的老婆和帮佣用的。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Now...
What you really
need is a ^FF3333manly Dagger^000000.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
现在……
你真正需要
的是一把^FF3333男子气概的短剑^000000。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Now...
What you really
need is a fine, exquisite
^FF3333French Dagger^000000 to match your beauty and elegance.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
现在……
你真正需要的是一把精致、优美的
^FF3333法式短剑^000000来匹配你的美丽和优雅。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
I call it...
The ^FF3333Main Gauche^000000! I invented it myself. And I'm only selling it for 9,400 zeny!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
我称它为……
^FF3333笨拙短剑^000000！我自己发明的。而且我只卖9,400泽尼！

scripts.text: Aren't you going to give me a sheath too?
scripts.translation: 你不打算也给我一个剑鞘吗？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
A sheath?
Whoa, that's almost asking too much! Alright, alright...
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
剑鞘？
哇，这要求有点过分了！好吧，好吧……

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Since I like you so much, I'm giving you a free sheath with your purchase! Now how's that
for a bargain?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
因为我这么喜欢你，购买时免费赠送你一个剑鞘！这交易怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
There's no way you can pass this up! Now, how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
你绝对不可能错过这个！现在，你想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Man, how many chances of a lifetime have you passed up? Man, I hope you win the lottery...
You'd probably
pass that up too.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
老兄，你错过了多少次千载难逢的机会？老兄，我希望你中彩票……
你可能也会
错过那个。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Whoa!
I can't sell that many Daggers! That'll attract the Prontera Chiv--I mean, um, I was gonna donate some Daggers to... Hungry children?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
哇！
我不能卖那么多短剑！那会吸引普隆德拉的骑士团——我是说，嗯，我打算捐赠一些短剑给……饥饿的孩子？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Short on zeny?
When the greatest deal in your life is right before your eyes?! Tragic, truly tragic...
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
缺泽尼？
当你一生中最好的交易就在眼前时？！悲剧，真是悲剧……

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
A Manteau? That's old news! You know what's the latest in protective armors?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
披风？那是旧闻了！你知道什么是最新的防护装甲吗？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Now why would such a beautiful woman wear something out of style? You know what would make you look even better?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
这么漂亮的女人为什么要穿过时 stuff？你知道什么会让你看起来更好吗？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
That's right!
A Hood! Wearing one of those is the quickest way to win respect these days!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
没错！
兜帽！戴上它是当今赢得尊重的最快方式！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
If you've got a Hood on, monsters will fear you and run away in terror! And check out this sturdy fabric. I can pull it all I want and it won't tear!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
如果你戴上兜帽，魔物会害怕你并惊恐地逃跑！看看这结实的面料。我怎么拉它都不会破！

scripts.text: This hood has no drawstrings...?
scripts.translation: 这兜帽没有抽绳……？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Haha! What are you saying? You don't need drawstrings! The space age Rayon and Nylon and Krypton fibers keep the Hood secure on your head!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
哈哈！你在说什么？你不需要抽绳！太空时代的 rayon、尼龙和氪纤维让兜帽牢牢固定在你的头上！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Man...
So much technology was invested into this Hood. Can you believe I'm only selling it for 930 zeny?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
老兄……
这么多技术投入到了这个兜帽里。你能相信我只卖930泽尼吗？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Clearly, this is the deal of the century. So how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
显然，这是世纪之交的交易。所以你想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Awww...
It wasn't because of the whole drawstrings thing, was it?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
哎呀……
不是因为抽绳的事，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Whoa~!
I can't sell you that many! What are you trying to do, take advantage of me?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
哇~！
我不能卖给你那么多！你想干什么，占我便宜？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Oh nuts...
Short on zeny, eh?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
哦，该死……
缺泽尼，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Man...
You sure like to ask for the impossible. Well, let me tell you right now. No other Merchant in the world sells the goods only I can offer.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
老兄……
你真喜欢强人所难。好吧，让我现在就告诉你。世界上没有其他商人出售只有我能提供的商品。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
You just gotta believe me!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
你必须相信我！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
No need to look anywhere else at all when I clearly have the best items around!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
既然我显然拥有周围最好的物品，就完全不需要去别处看了！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Guy]
Please come back sometime, and buy more of my stuff. I love a customer who knows what they want! Hehe~
scripts.translation:
[可疑的家伙]
请有空再来，多买点我的东西。我喜欢知道自己想要什么的顾客！嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Crumpler]
Ooooh~!
You sure are dressed pretty,
ya fancy schmancy Mage!
scripts.translation:
[克伦普勒]
噢~！
你穿得真漂亮，
你这个花哨的魔法师！

scripts.text: ^3355FFSomeday, you swear to yourself, you will have your bloody revenge on this belligerent drunk for besmirching the proud Mage profession. Someday...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF总有一天，你向自己发誓，你要对这个侮辱骄傲的魔法师职业的挑衅醉汉进行血腥的复仇。总有一天……^000000

scripts.text: Actually, I'm a Wizard.
scripts.translation: 其实，我是巫师。

scripts.text:
[Crumpler]
I'm so scared!
A Wizard?! Bwahaha!
scripts.translation:
[克伦普勒]
我好怕！
巫师？！哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Crumpler]
Everyone knows Wizards are all intelligence and no strength! Come on, smart man! Show me how tough you are!
scripts.translation:
[克伦普勒]
大家都知道巫师只有智力没有力量！来吧，聪明人！让我看看你有多厉害！

scripts.text: Meteor Storm!
scripts.translation: 陨石术！

scripts.text: Lord of Vermilion!
scripts.translation: 怒雷强击！

scripts.text: Show Mercy.
scripts.translation: 手下留情。

scripts.text:
[Crumpler]
Huh?
What'd you just say?
scripts.translation:
[克伦普勒]
哈？
你刚才说什么？

scripts.text:
[Crumpler]
...
scripts.translation:
[克伦普勒]
...

scripts.text:
[Crumpler]
...
......

[Crumpler]
Ooooooooh
crraaaap!
scripts.translation:
[克伦普勒]
噢~~~~~~~
该死！

scripts.text:
[Crumpler]
Help meeeee!
scripts.translation:
[克伦普勒]
救救我！

scripts.text:
[Crumpler]
Hahahahaah!
Silly Wizard! Only a monster like Baphomet can handle a big spell like th--
scripts.translation:
[克伦普勒]
哈哈哈哈！
愚蠢的巫师！只有像巴风特这样的魔物才能承受这么大的法术——

scripts.text:
[Crumpler]
Oh sweet lord...
You're serious...
scripts.translation:
[克伦普勒]
哦，亲爱的主……
你是认真的……

scripts.text:
[Crumpler]
ARRRRRGH~!
IT BUUUURNS!
scripts.translation:
[克伦普勒]
啊啊啊啊~！
好烫！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No...
I can only use
my powers for good.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不……
我只能为了善
使用我的力量。

scripts.text:
[Crumpler]
Haw haw!
Good...
For nothing!
scripts.translation:
[克伦普勒]
哈！
好……
没用！

scripts.text: Actually, sir, I'm a Sage.
scripts.translation: 其实，先生，我是贤者。

scripts.text:
[Crumpler]
A...
Sage?
scripts.translation:
[克伦普勒]
一个……
贤者？

scripts.text:
[Crumpler]
I don't know what that is. But I guess it can't be half as bad as a Mage.
scripts.translation:
[克伦普勒]
我不知道那是什么。但我想它不会比魔法师坏到哪里去。

scripts.text:
[Crumpler]
Soooo...
Wanna drink with me?
scripts.translation:
[克伦普勒]
所以……
想和我一起喝酒吗？

scripts.text:
[Crumpler]
Wait a sec...
You're not a Mage!
J-just how drunk am I?!
scripts.translation:
[克伦普勒]
等一下……
你不是魔法师！
我-我到底喝多了多少？！

scripts.text:
[Crumpler]
Man, I hate Mages with a passion! Always studying and chanting and making taxes high and stuff...
scripts.translation:
[克伦普勒]
老兄，我恨透了魔法师！总是学习、吟唱、抬高税收之类的……

scripts.text:
[Crumpler]
Taking our jobs, censoring the media, ruining our education system, causing air pollution, starting wars, making rap music...
scripts.translation:
[克伦普勒]
抢我们的工作，审查媒体，破坏我们的教育系统，造成空气污染，发动战争，制作说唱音乐……

scripts.text:
[Skyler]
Hello hello.
You're not looking
for Eric, are you?
scripts.translation:
[斯凯勒]
你好你好。
你不是在找
埃里克，对吧？

scripts.text: Eric? Who's that?
scripts.translation: 埃里克？那是谁？

scripts.text: Yes. Yes, I am.
scripts.translation: 是的。是的，我是。

scripts.text:
[Skyler]
Oh, I see. He's just some guy in the room to the left of me. He's always working on some sort of project.
scripts.translation:
[斯凯勒]
哦，我明白了。他只是我左边房间里的一个人。他总是在做一些项目。

scripts.text:
[Skyler]
Something to do with these magic sort of Ear Muffs. I guess he's been looking for investors to help him finish building whatever he's making.
scripts.translation:
[斯凯勒]
和一些魔法耳罩有关。我想他一直在寻找投资者来帮助他完成正在制造的东西。

scripts.text:
[Skyler]
Oh, alright. You can find Eric in the room to the left of me. He'll probably be happy to know someone is interested in what he's trying to build.
scripts.translation:
[斯凯勒]
哦，好吧。你可以在我左边的房间里找到埃里克。如果有人对他试图建造的东西感兴趣，他可能会很高兴。

scripts.text:
[Skyler]
From what I remember, he seemed really discouraged, thinking he'd never be able to finish his little project.
scripts.translation:
[斯凯勒]
据我所知，他似乎很沮丧，认为他永远无法完成他的小项目。

scripts.text:
[Skyler]
I'm glad to hear you've come this way to help out that young fellow.
scripts.translation:
[斯凯勒]
我很高兴听到你来这里帮助那个年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
This place...
Certainly has
atmosphere.
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
这个地方……
确实很有
氛围。

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
We've got some kind of Fortune Teller that's always hanging around in the corner, and a loud, belligerent drunk who's always picking on Mages.
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
我们角落里总挂着一个算命师，还有一个总是欺负魔法师大声且好斗的醉汉。

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
So...
What can
I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
所以……
我能为你
做些什么？

scripts.text: May I have a drink?
scripts.translation: 我可以喝一杯吗？

scripts.text: Is there any interesting gossip?
scripts.translation: 有什么有趣的八卦吗？

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
Well...
If you're looking for alcohol, King Tristram III outlawed it a while ago. Now I hear they only serve it in certain places.
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
嗯……
如果你在找酒，特里斯坦三世国王不久前禁止了它。现在我听说他们只在某些地方供应。

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
Still, people manage to get drunk off the imitation drinks that we serve here. I guess it's all psychological.
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
不过，人们还是能通过喝我们这里供应的仿制饮料喝醉。我想这都是心理作用。

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
I reeeeally want to be able to visit that place where they serve real drinks. I hear it's just like paradise!
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
我真的很想去那个供应真酒的地方看看。听说那里就像天堂一样！

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
Gossip...?
Well, I've heard that they're opening a new Airship Service
in Juno!
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
八卦……？
嗯，我听说朱诺要开通新的飞空艇服务！

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
Or at least, they're planning to. The airship isn't really ready to take off just yet. In the meantime, there's some weird customer representative over there who's offering a teleport service.
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
或者至少，他们正计划这样做。飞空艇还没准备好起飞。与此同时，那边有个奇怪的客户代表提供瞬间移动服务。

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
It seems like Kafra Corporation may finally have a competitor! Then again, I don't think many girls are as attractive as the Kafra Employees...
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
看来卡普拉公司终于要有竞争对手了！话说回来，我觉得没有多少女孩能像卡普拉服务员那样有吸引力……

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
Have you heard?
There are some new fashions floating around the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom!
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
你听说了吗？
卢恩·米德加兹王国周围流行一些新时尚！

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
People have been coming in, wearing some cute new hats. There was this cute Teddy Bear Hat I've never seen before, and a girl came in wearing these black Kitty Ears...
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
人们进来时戴着一些可爱的新帽子。有一个我以前从未见过的可爱泰迪熊帽子，还有一个女孩戴着黑色的猫咪耳朵……

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
Of course, not every popular style suits my taste. I mean, I saw someone walking around with a Mushroom on their head. And I hear someone has been making hats made out of Fish?
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
当然，并不是每种流行风格都符合我的品味。我的意思是，我看到有人头上顶着蘑菇到处走。我还听说有人用鱼做帽子？

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
I guess those
kinds of hats are too
artistic for my taste.
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
我想那些
帽子对我的品味来说
太艺术了。

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
Gossip, eh?
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
八卦，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
Well...
I hear there's this person somewhere in Rune-Midgarts...
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
嗯……
我听说卢恩·米德加兹某处有个人……

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
Tell me, have you ever heard of {0}? He's supposed to be the suavest hero around!
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
告诉我，你听说过{0}吗？他被认为是周围最潇洒的英雄！

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
Have you ever heard of {0}? People say she's one of the prettiest girls in all of Rune-Midgarts!
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
你听说过{0}吗？人们说她是整个卢恩·米德加兹最漂亮的女孩之一！

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
Gossip, eh?
W-wait...
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
八卦，是吗？
等-等等……

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
Ugh...
Ooooh...
My he-head...
It huuurts...
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
呃……
噢……
我的头……
好痛……

scripts.text:
[William's Spirit]
^990000You get the hell away from my daughter, low-life, before I sell your organs for zeny!
You hear me?!^000000
scripts.translation:
[威廉的灵魂]
^990000离我女儿远点，你这低等人，否则我就把你的器官卖了换泽尼！
听见了吗？！^000000

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
*Cough*
Oh...!
Sorry about that!
I must be coming
down with the flu!
...Or something.
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
*咳嗽*
哦……！
抱歉！
我一定是得了流感！
……或者是别的什么。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWeird...
Her voice was
really deep for
a minute there...
scripts.translation:
^3355FF奇怪……
她的声音刚才
真的很低沉……

scripts.text:
[William's Spirit]
^990000Hey you sex crazed bastard!! Stop looking at my daughter like that before I rip out your eyes, and eat them with pasta!^000000
scripts.translation:
[威廉的灵魂]
^990000嘿，你这个色鬼！！别再那样看我女儿，否则我就挖出你的眼睛，配着意面吃掉！^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh...?
C-come again?

[{0}]
W-waaaaait~
But, But I'm a girl!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等-等等~
但，但我是个女孩！

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
Huh...?
Oh, Dad must have possessed me again. It happens to me and my sister all the time.
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
哈……？
哦，爸爸一定又附身我了。我和我姐姐经常发生这种事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No kidding?
Huh. Total bummer.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是开玩笑吧？
哈。真扫兴。

scripts.text:
[Elenore]
Yeah...
Tell me about it.
scripts.translation:
[埃莉诺]
是啊……
别提了。

scripts.text:
[William's Spirit]
^990000What part of ^FF0000I will whup you where you stand^000000 ^990000do you not understand?! Now, quit it you pervert!^000000
scripts.translation:
[威廉的灵魂]
^990000你哪部分不理解^FF0000我会当场揍你^000000 ^990000？！现在，住手，你这个变态！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWaaah~!
How did she
get all scary?!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF哇~！
她怎么变得
这么可怕？！^000000

scripts.text:
[Elisa]
Hello there~
Can I help you
with anything?
scripts.translation:
[伊丽莎]
你好~
有什么我可以
帮你的吗？

scripts.text: May I ask for a drink?
scripts.translation: 我可以要一杯饮料吗？

scripts.text: Is there any interesting gossip lately?
scripts.translation: 最近有什么有趣的八卦吗？

scripts.text:
[Elisa]
A...
Drink?
scripts.translation:
[伊丽莎]
一……
饮料？

scripts.text:
[Elisa]
You know that we don't serve alcohol here anymore. We just have all these fake, flavorless drinks that have no effect. Yeah, they're pretty boring...
scripts.translation:
[伊丽莎]
你知道我们这里不再供应酒精了。我们只有所有这些虚假、无味、没有效果的饮料。是的，它们很无聊……

scripts.text:
[Elisa]
We pretty much only serve water around here. That, and really bad alcoholic imitation drinks.
scripts.translation:
[伊丽莎]
我们这里基本上只供应水。还有，真的很糟糕的酒精仿制饮料。

scripts.text:
[Elisa]
It's horrible that King Tristram III outlawed alcohol in the kingdom! It's probably the only bad decision he's made throughout his entire reign!
scripts.translation:
[伊丽莎]
特里斯坦三世国王在王国禁止酒精真是太糟糕了！这可能是他整个统治期间做出的唯一错误决定！

scripts.text:
[Elisa]
You know
what's so weird?
scripts.translation:
[伊丽莎]
你知道
什么很奇怪吗？

scripts.text:
[Elisa]
I went down to the Prontera Sanctuary, and I could have sworn
that a Priest got married to a Priestess!
scripts.translation:
[伊丽莎]
我去了普隆德拉圣堂，我敢肯定
看到一个牧师和一个女祭司结婚了！

scripts.text:
[Elisa]
I really had no idea whether or not Priests could marry, but since King Tristram III was there himself,
I suppose that it's okay!
scripts.translation:
[伊丽莎]
我真的不知道牧师是否可以结婚，但因为特里斯坦三世国王亲自在那里，
我想那是可以的！

scripts.text:
[Elisa]
I don't like to stereotype people, but haven't you noticed that Swordsmen and Knights
tend to be, you know...
scripts.translation:
[伊丽莎]
我不喜欢给人贴标签，但你有没有注意到剑士和骑士
往往，你知道……

scripts.text:
[Elisa]
...INT challenged?
All they seem to know
is smashing things!
scripts.translation:
[伊丽莎]
……智力低下？
他们似乎只知道
砸东西！

scripts.text:
[Elisa]
Rumors...?
Hmmmm, well...
scripts.translation:
[伊丽莎]
谣言……？
嗯……

scripts.text:
[Elisa]
You know the name
of our kingdom, right?
The Rune-Midgarts Kingdom?
scripts.translation:
[伊丽莎]
你知道我们王国的名字，对吧？
卢恩·米德加兹王国？

scripts.text:
[Elisa]
I hear that it was originally called the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, after our continent. However, for some reason, the name was changed to 'Rune-Midgarts.'
scripts.translation:
[伊丽莎]
我听说它最初是以我们的大陆命名的，叫卢恩·米德加兹王国。然而，出于某种原因，名字改成了‘卢恩·米德加兹’。

scripts.text:
[Elisa]
It was obviously a wise decision, since too many people kept confusing the our continent with our kingdom. Weird, huh?
scripts.translation:
[伊丽莎]
这显然是一个明智的决定，因为太多人把我们的大陆和我们的王国搞混了。奇怪，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Elisa]
Rumors...?
Hmmmm, well...
scripts.translation:
[伊丽莎]
谣言……？
嗯……

scripts.text:
[Elisa]
That's funny...
I, I can't think of anything. E-everything feels so fuzzy...
scripts.translation:
[伊丽莎]
真有趣……
我，我想不出任何东西。一-切都感觉很模糊……

scripts.text:
[William's Spirit]
^990000Stay away from my daughter, or I'll beat your brains out, punk! Elisa's gonna marry a doctor! Or a lawyer!^000000
scripts.translation:
[威廉的灵魂]
^990000离我女儿远点，否则我就把你打得脑浆迸裂，小混混！伊丽莎要嫁给医生！或者律师！^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Y-y-y-yes, sir!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是-是-是-是的，先生！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But...
I'm a girl!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是……
我是个女孩！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThat was scary...!
It looks like a father's love endures forever, even in the afterlife.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF真吓人……！
看来父亲的爱即使在死后也永恒不变。^000000

scripts.text:
[William's Spirit]
^990000WHAT...?!
That's even worse!!^000000

^3355FFThat was scary...!
It looks like a father's love endures forever, even in the afterlife.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF真吓人……！
看来父亲的爱即使在死后也永恒不变。^000000

scripts.text:
[William's Spirit]
^990000How dare you try to pick up on my precious daughter! Do you wish to taste an angry father's fury?!^000000
scripts.translation:
[威廉的灵魂]
^990000你怎么敢试图勾引我宝贵的女儿！你想尝尝愤怒父亲的怒火吗？！^000000

scripts.text:
[Elisa]
W-whoa...!
I'm so sorry!
scripts.translation:
[伊丽莎]
哇-哇……！
真对不起！

scripts.text:
[Elisa]
It's just...
The spirit of my father,
God rest his soul, is
a little overprotective!
scripts.translation:
[伊丽莎]
只是……
我父亲的灵魂，
愿他安息，有点
过度保护！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou step away.
Very. Carefully.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你退后。
非常。小心地。^000000

scripts.text:
[Merchant Daven]
I remember Geffen
back when it was boring.
scripts.translation:
[商人 达文]
我记得吉芬
以前很无聊的时候。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Daven]
But now there are Mages and Wizards, and a flourishing
economy in this town!
scripts.translation:
[商人 达文]
但现在这里有魔法师和巫师，这个城镇的经济也很繁荣！

scripts.text: Mages...?
scripts.translation: 魔法师……？

scripts.text: Economy?
scripts.translation: 经济？

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Daven]
Mages are wielders of magic. But you would know more about that topic now, wouldn't you?
scripts.translation:
[商人 达文]
魔法师是魔法的使用者。但你现在应该更了解这个话题，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Daven]
Mages and Wizards are always carrying books and studying magic. That's just the way they are.
scripts.translation:
[商人 达文]
魔法师和巫师总是带着书研究魔法。他们就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Daven]
There's a Magic School in the NorthWest part of the city for Novices interested in becoming Mages. There, they can learn the basics of magic.
scripts.translation:
[商人 达文]
城市西北部有一所魔法学校，供有兴趣成为魔法师的初心者学习。在那里，他们可以学习魔法的基础知识。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Daven]
After becoming well experienced in the use of magic, Mages can become qualified to become Wizards.
scripts.translation:
[商人 达文]
在熟练使用魔法后，魔法师就有资格成为巫师。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Daven]
Wizards have access to more powerful and destructive magic spells than Mages. Mages can apply to become Wizards at the top of Geffen Tower.
scripts.translation:
[商人 达文]
巫师可以使用比魔法师更强大和更具破坏性的魔法咒语。魔法师可以在吉芬塔顶层申请成为巫师。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Daven]
The economy...?
Why, that's all thanks to Blacksmiths! But you should know that already, shouldn't you?
scripts.translation:
[商人 达文]
经济……？
为什么，那都要感谢铁匠！但你应该已经知道了，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Daven]
Well, I guess you can thank the Blacksmiths for the economy here in Geffen. Sure, they always dirty, sweaty, smelly and talk kind of rudely...
scripts.translation:
[商人 达文]
嗯，我想你可以感谢吉芬这里的铁匠促进了经济。当然，他们总是脏兮兮、汗流浃背、臭烘烘的，说话也有点粗鲁……

scripts.text:
[Merchant Daven]
But they're hard working people. Also, the ores they refine and the weapons they create are high in demand.
scripts.translation:
[商人 达文]
但他们是勤劳的人。此外，他们提炼的矿石和制造的武器需求量很大。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Daven]
Adventurers pay Blacksmiths lots of their hard earned zeny for the high quality weapons that only they can create.
scripts.translation:
[商人 达文]
冒险者支付大量辛苦赚来的泽尼给铁匠，购买只有他们才能制造的高质量武器。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Daven]
Me? I'm the world's most prettiest street merchant. Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[商人 达文]
我？我是世界上最漂亮的街头商人。嘿嘿~

scripts.text: ...^EE0000Magnum Break^000000!

[Merchant Daven]
Whoa, whoa!
It was just a joke!
Forgive me!
scripts.translation:
[商人 达文]
哇，哇！
只是个玩笑！
原谅我！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Daven]
Magnum Break?
But you can't even do that, can you?
scripts.translation:
[商人 达文]
怒爆？
但你甚至不会那个，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Hans Hadenheim]
Man, the Midgard continent sure is big! How's it going, youngster?
scripts.translation:
[汉斯·哈登海姆]
老兄，米德加尔特大陆真大！你好吗，年轻人？

scripts.text:
[Hans Hadenheim]
This Geffen sure is strange. But it was worth it to travel here all the way from the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[汉斯·哈登海姆]
这个吉芬真奇怪。但从修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国大老远跑来这里还是值得的。

scripts.text: Schwarzwald Republic?
scripts.translation: 修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国？

scripts.text: So, why are you traveling?
scripts.translation: 那么，你为什么旅行？

scripts.text:
[Hans Hadenheim]
You...
Don't know the
Schwarzwald Republic?
scripts.translation:
[汉斯·哈登海姆]
你……
不知道
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国？

scripts.text:
[Hans Hadenheim]
You know, ally of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. Um... Our capital city is Juno?
scripts.translation:
[汉斯·哈登海姆]
你知道，卢恩·米德加兹王国的盟友。嗯……我们的首都是朱诺？

scripts.text:
[Hans Hadenheim]
You should really
read up on your
world events!
scripts.translation:
[汉斯·哈登海姆]
你真的应该
多关注一下
世界大事！

scripts.text:
[Hans Hadenheim]
Oh, you know, for business. It seems there's a lot of good money in foreign commerce.
scripts.translation:
[汉斯·哈登海姆]
哦，你知道，为了生意。看来对外贸易有很多好钱可赚。

scripts.text:
[Hans Hadenheim]
I mean, all these new cities are being discovered by explorers, so import and export trade is really booming!
scripts.translation:
[汉斯·哈登海姆]
我的意思是，探险家们正在发现所有这些新城市，所以进出口贸易真的在蓬勃发展！

scripts.text:
[Hans Handenheim]
You're in the trading business yourself, right? So of course you'd understand that we're in a Golden Age of trade!
scripts.translation:
[汉斯·汉登海姆]
你自己也在做贸易生意，对吧？所以你当然明白我们正处于贸易的黄金时代！

scripts.text:
[Hans Handenheim]
I guess...
Those kinds of concepts might be too high brow for a rookie like you.
scripts.translation:
[汉斯·汉登海姆]
我想……
那些概念对像你这样的新人来说可能太高深了。

scripts.text:
[Hans Handenheim]
Anyway...
scripts.translation:
[汉斯·汉登海姆]
总之……

scripts.text:
[Hans Hadenheim]
Have you been some of these new lands? They're really interesting and you can learn a lot of new things from these foreign cultures.
scripts.translation:
[汉斯·哈登海姆]
你去过这些新土地吗？它们真的很有趣，你可以从这些外国文化中学到很多新东西。

scripts.text:
[Hans Hadenheim]
Still, if you want to go sightseeing, I personally recommend that you visit my hometown of Juno. It's quite beautiful, you know.
scripts.translation:
[汉斯·哈登海姆]
不过，如果你想观光，我个人建议你参观我的家乡朱诺。你知道，那里相当美丽。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Ah...
Don't tell me! You've come to have your fortune told, yes? I know,
I know... I can see the future! So what kind of fortune do you want?
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
啊……
别告诉我！你是来算命的，对吧？我知道，
我知道……我能看到未来！所以你想要什么样的运势？

scripts.text: Life!
scripts.translation: 生活！

scripts.text: Love!
scripts.translation: 爱情！

scripts.text: Money!
scripts.translation: 金钱！

scripts.text: Grades!
scripts.translation: 成绩！

scripts.text: Future!
scripts.translation: 未来！

scripts.text: Fashion!
scripts.translation: 时尚！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Life...?
Wow, that's a really broad category. But let me contact some spirits of the spirit world and I'll see what I can do.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
生活……？
哇，这是一个非常广泛的类别。但让我联系一下灵界的一些灵魂，看看我能做什么。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Hmm...
What can I tell you about life? Let me contact the spirit world real quick~
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
嗯……
关于生活我能告诉你什么？让我快速联系一下灵界~

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
I sense that you may be about to make a rash decision that you might regret. I must advise you to slow down and think first.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
我感觉你可能即将做出一个你会后悔的草率决定。我必须建议你放慢脚步，先思考一下。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Hmmm... I sense that you are experiencing a loss of direction in life. Should you prioritize security or happiness?
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
嗯……我感觉你正在经历人生方向的迷失。你应该优先考虑安全感还是幸福？

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Hmm...
I sense that you've had a quarrel with someone close to you. Someone for whom you care for dearly.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
嗯……
我感觉你和亲近的人发生了争吵。一个你非常关心的人。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
[Psychic Advisor]
Well, I hope I settled any doubts you've had about the future. That is, after all, my job as a professional psychic consultant. Come back anytime~
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
[灵媒顾问]
嗯，希望我解决了你对未来的任何疑虑。毕竟，这是我作为专业灵媒顾问的工作。随时回来~

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Hmmm...
Alright, I got something. Ummmm, you will live to be very, very old. How old you ask?
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
嗯……
好吧，我有点眉目了。嗯，你会活得很老很老。多老你问？

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
^333333*cough!*^000000ty-nine years old. Isn't that good news? That's a ripe old age, and you have plenty of blissful years left to enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
^333333*咳嗽！*^000000九十九岁。这不是好消息吗？那是高寿，你还有很多幸福的岁月可以享受。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Also, you'll always be successful. You'll successfully win in life and you'll successfully lose in life!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
此外，你总会成功。你会成功地赢得人生，也会成功地输掉人生！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
You might not understand that little nugget of wisdom now, but as you learn more about this crazy, crazy world, it will make more sense.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
你现在可能不理解这点智慧，但随着你对这个疯狂的世界了解更多，它会更有意义。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Alright, I got it!
Your dreams
will come true!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
好吧，我知道了！
你的梦想
会成真！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Of course, I'm not sure exactly which dreams will come true, but hopefully the good dreams that you've had will become reality, rather than any of your weird nightmares.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
当然，我不确定具体哪些梦想会成真，但希望你做过的好梦会成为现实，而不是任何奇怪的噩梦。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Which dreams exactly? Well, the spirits are awfully reticent today. They're not exactly in the mood to talk. Spirits have lives too, you know. Wait, did that make any sense?
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
具体哪些梦想？嗯，灵魂们今天非常沉默寡言。他们没有心情说话。灵魂也有生活，你知道。等等，这有意义吗？

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Although the pressure may be high, remember that any decision made in excitement is usually a bad decision. Take a deep breath and relax.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
虽然压力可能很大，但记住，兴奋时做出的决定通常是坏决定。深呼吸，放松一下。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Even if you're running out of time, it's better to slowly plan things out so that you don't waste any of your efforts, or make costly mistakes.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
即使时间紧迫，慢慢计划事情也比浪费精力或犯下代价高昂的错误要好。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Remember that calm,
collected patience
is the key to overcoming crisis.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
记住，冷静、
沉着的耐心
是克服危机的关键。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
I suggest that you think fully and carefully before deciding what path is best for you. And remember, you can only learn from your mistakes.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
我建议你在决定哪条路最适合你之前充分仔细地思考。记住，你只能从错误中学习。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
If you plan carefully and perform positive, constructive actions with a good attitude, you can
have it all!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
如果你仔细计划并以良好的态度采取积极、建设性的行动，你可以
拥有一切！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
You must take the initiative! Try and resolve this matter without getting too caught up in your emotions.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
你必须采取主动！尝试解决这件事，不要过于陷入情绪之中。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Try to make amends, swallow your pride and apologize sincerely if you have to. Isn't friendship worth it? I think so.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
尝试和解，放下自尊，必要时真诚道歉。友谊不值得吗？我认为是的。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Well, I hope I settled any doubts you've had about the future. That is, after all, my job as a professional psychic consultant. Come back anytime~
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
嗯，希望我解决了你对未来的任何疑虑。毕竟，这是我作为专业灵媒顾问的工作。随时回来~

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
You want to know your Love fortune? Oh ho~ Then there must be somebody that you like! Come on, you can tell me!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
你想知道你的爱情运势？哦呵~那你一定有心仪的人了！来吧，你可以告诉我！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Looooove, eh? 
Let me contact
the spirits for a second.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
爱~~~~情，是吗？
让我联系一下
灵魂片刻。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Um...
The girl that you
are currently seeing
is perfect for you!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
嗯……
你目前正在交往的
女孩非常适合你！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Um...
The boy that you
are currently seeing
is perfect for you!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
嗯……
你目前正在交往的
男孩非常适合你！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Looking for romance, eh? Life can always use a little more excitement.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
寻找浪漫，是吗？生活总是可以多一点刺激。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
[Psychic Advisor]
Love is always fun! Even in this bleak world, love surrounds us in its inviting glow. Treasure that person who is special to you, and come back for another reading!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
[灵媒顾问]
爱总是有趣的！即使在这个凄凉的世界里，爱也以其诱人的光芒围绕着我们。珍惜那个对你特别的人，再来占卜一次！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Oh right...
Um, I sense a strong love energy emanating from your soul. It's quite intimidating and pushes away the weak and the spineless.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
哦对了……
嗯，我感觉你的灵魂散发出强烈的爱情能量。它相当具有威慑力，吓退了软弱和无骨气的人。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
So basically, I foresee that you'll only be attracting really strong people soon. You know, like professional athletes, bodybuilders, construction workers, that sort of thing.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
所以基本上，我预见你很快就会吸引非常强壮的人。你知道，比如职业运动员、健美运动员、建筑工人之类的人。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
So if this is what you want, congratulations! Fortune smiles upon you with joy this day.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
所以如果这是你想要的，恭喜！命运今天带着喜悦向你微笑。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
But if this is the opposite of what you want, well, I'm sorry. Fortune smiles upon you with sarcasm this day. But it's not too late to change destiny!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
但如果这与你的愿望相反，好吧，我很抱歉。命运今天带着讽刺向你微笑。但改变命运还为时不晚！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Ah! An old flame will return! I don't know if they'll fall in love with you again, ask you for money, or if that person's back for revenge...
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
啊！旧情人会回来！我不知道他们是否会再次爱上你，向你借钱，还是那个人回来复仇……

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
But an old flame will definitely resurface in your life. Somehow. So if that's good news, congratulations! But, if that's bad news, then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
但旧情人肯定会以某种方式重新出现在你的生活中。所以如果是好消息，恭喜！但如果是坏消息，那就小心了！

scripts.text: How did you know?
scripts.translation: 你怎么知道的？

scripts.text: You're so wrong!
scripts.translation: 你错得太离谱了！

scripts.text: I'm single!
scripts.translation: 我是单身！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Well...
We psychics are pretty accurate at this kind of thing. And it's so good to see that you're really happy with your partner!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
嗯……
我们灵媒在这方面相当准确。看到你和你伴侣真的很开心真好！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
You didn't let me finish my sentence. What I meant to say was...
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
你没让我把话说完。我的意思是……

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
The girl that you
are currently seeing is perfect for you if you want to live the rest of your life in utter misery!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
你目前正在交往的
女孩非常适合你，如果你想余生都生活在彻底的痛苦中！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
The boy that you
are currently seeing is perfect for you if you want to live the rest of your life in utter misery!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
你目前正在交往的
男孩非常适合你，如果你想余生都生活在彻底的痛苦中！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
But even if you break up, do it as soon as possible and try to be good friends after the matter.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
但即使分手，也要尽快分，事后尽量做好朋友。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
It'll make better people out of both of you. But that's just what I think.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
这会让你们俩都变成更好的人。但这只是我的想法。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Oh...
Um, I'm sorry.
Sometimes, I get the future and the present mixed up. You know, since I'm always looking into the future...?
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
哦……
嗯，对不起。
有时，我把未来和现在搞混了。你知道，因为我总是展望未来……？

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
What I meant to say was
^3355FFyou and the perfect woman will soon fall in love^000000. Yes, that's what I meant!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
我的意思是
^3355FF你很快会和完美女人坠入爱河^000000。是的，我就是这个意思！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
What I meant to say was
^3355FFyou will soon be swept off your feet by the perfect guy^000000. Yes, that's what I meant!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
我的意思是
^3355FF你很快会被完美男人迷倒^000000。是的，我就是这个意思！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
That's strange, I foresee a Love Triangle in your future. No, wait! A Love...
Decagon?
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
真奇怪，我预见到你未来会有三角恋。不，等等！一个爱……
十边形？

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
What's the shape with eleven sides? Now, you can't expect me to know that off the top of my head. I'm a psychic, not a mathematician!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
十一边形的形状叫什么？现在，你不能指望我脱口而出就知道。我是灵媒，不是数学家！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Love is always fun! Even in this bleak world, love surrounds us in its inviting glow. Treasure that person who is special to you, and come back for another reading!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
爱总是有趣的！即使在这个凄凉的世界里，爱也以其诱人的光芒围绕着我们。珍惜那个对你特别的人，再来占卜一次！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Money? Well, you must be more fortunate in money than I am. After all, I sit here all day and give this service for free!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
金钱？嗯，你在金钱方面一定比我幸运。毕竟，我整天坐在这里免费提供这项服务！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Ah yes. Let me contact the spirit world. They usually have sound financial advice, despite the fact that don't have any sort of economy over there.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
啊是的。让我联系灵界。他们通常有合理的财务建议，尽管那里没有任何形式的经济。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
So you want to know about money, eh? Let me commune with the spirits of the supernatural realm...
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
所以你想知道关于金钱的事，是吗？让我与超自然领域的灵魂沟通……

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
[Psychic Advisor]
Well, you need money to live, but having money alone isn't living. Don't forget that there are other important things. And try not to stress out, okay?
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
[灵媒顾问]
嗯，你需要钱生活，但只有钱不是生活。别忘了还有其他重要的事情。尽量不要压力大，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Well...
Um, the spirits tell me that you might not win the lottery, no matter how many tickets you buy. I'm sorry, but it's true.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
嗯……
嗯，灵魂告诉我，无论你买多少彩票，你可能都不会中奖。对不起，但这是真的。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
But I just saved you a lifetime's worth of lottery tickets! That could be quite a hefty sum of money!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
但我刚刚为你节省了一辈子的彩票钱！那可能是一笔巨款！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
First off, be accountable for your own money and use a budget that works for you. A good rule of thumb? For every ten zeny you earn, put one zeny aside and either save it or invest it for later.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
首先，对自己的钱负责，并使用适合你的预算。一个好的经验法则？每赚十泽尼，留出一泽尼存起来或投资以备后用。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
And whatever you do, don't work as a psychic advisor in Rune-Midgarts. The real cash, apparently, is in discovering new countries. Why didn't I do that?!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
无论如何，不要在卢恩·米德加兹当灵媒顾问。真正的现金，显然，在于发现新国家。我为什么不那样做？！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Ah yes. They are telling me that it's best to be moderate in all things. Certainly, you must make sure that your expenditures don't exceed your budget.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
啊是的。他们告诉我凡事适度最好。当然，你必须确保你的支出不超过预算。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
However, you should also avoid gambling with your money. By that, I mean you should save and invest carefully. Don't be tempted into risky get-rich-quick schemes!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
然而，你也应该避免拿钱赌博。我的意思是，你应该谨慎储蓄和投资。不要被高风险的快速致富计划诱惑！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
On the other hand, get-rich-not-as-quick schemes are okay, so long as you know what you are doing. I'm right, aren't I?
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
另一方面，不那么快速的致富计划是可以的，只要你知道自己在做什么。我是对的，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Well, you need money to live, but having money alone isn't living. Don't forget that there are other important things. And try not to stress out, okay?
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
嗯，你需要钱生活，但只有钱不是生活。别忘了还有其他重要的事情。尽量不要压力大，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Your grades? You're still in school? I'm impressed! Your eyes tell me you are rather mature for your age. Alright, let me contact the spirits...
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
你的成绩？你还在上学？我印象深刻！你的眼神告诉我你比同龄人成熟得多。好吧，让我联系灵魂……

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
You're asking me about your grades? That's weird. I mean, they only ask about your report card at school, right?
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
你问我关于你的成绩？真奇怪。我的意思是，学校里只问你的成绩单，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
^FF0000F MINUS^000000!
Hahahahahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
^FF0000F减^000000！
哈哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Oh cool!
I sense that you will soon be receiving straight A's...
In Effort!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
哦酷！
我感觉你很快就会拿到全A……
在努力方面！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
[Psychic Advisor]
Well, in any case, concentrating on your studies is tough, but it can be rewarding. I hope you do well in whatever you choose to do~
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
[灵媒顾问]
嗯，无论如何，专注于学习很难，但会有回报。希望你无论选择做什么都做得好~

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Hm? All the spirits said was 'Did you study?' Well, I guess I answered your question with yet another question!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
哈？灵魂们只说了‘你学习了吗？’好吧，我想我用另一个问题回答了你的问题！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
An education is really important, but don't be discouraged if your grades aren't as good as you'd like.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
教育真的很重要，但如果你的成绩不如你所愿，不要气馁。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Perhaps your style of learning isn't really supported by your school, or maybe you're not that interested in academics. Understandable.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
也许你的学习风格不受学校支持，或者你对学术不太感兴趣。可以理解。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
The spirits tell me that you should experiment with different learning styles, so that you can make sure that you get the grades that you want.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
灵魂告诉我，你应该尝试不同的学习风格，以确保你获得想要的成绩。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Yeah...
The spirits are
awfully lazy today.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
是啊……
灵魂们今天
特别懒。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Oh, I'm sorry, I just love doing that. Okay, let me ask the spirits for real this time. Hmmmm...
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
哦，对不起，我就是喜欢那样做。好吧，这次让我真正问问灵魂。嗯……

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Hmm. The spirits are being awfully rude today. They're saying, 'If you're so worried about your grades, why don't you ask your teacher?'
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
嗯。灵魂们今天非常无礼。他们说，‘如果你这么担心成绩，为什么不问你的老师？’

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Now that I think about it, they do have a point. Why don't you ask your teacher, professor or whatever to see if you have any problems?
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
现在我想起来，他们说得有道理。你为什么不问问你的老师、教授或其他人，看看你是否有任何问题？

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
I mean, they're being paid to help you. And well, my service is free. So... Yeah.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
我的意思是，他们收钱是为了帮助你。而我的服务是免费的。所以……是的。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Now, I couldn't tell you what your real grades are. You might be destined to get an A in every class or subject, but if I told you that...
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
现在，我无法告诉你你真实的成绩是多少。你可能注定每门课或科目都得A，但如果我告诉你……

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
You'd probably get cocky, slack off on studying, fail your classes and cause a time paradox. I mean, I have to actually be in the future to actually see it, you know?
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
你可能会变得自大，放松学习，考试不及格并导致时间悖论。我的意思是，我必须实际上在未来才能真正看到它，你知道？

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Instead of worrying about time paradoxes, why don't you make your own destiny?
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
与其担心时间悖论，为什么不创造你自己的命运？

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Well, in any case, concentrating on your studies is tough, but it can be rewarding. I hope you do well in whatever you choose to do~
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
嗯，无论如何，专注于学习很难，但会有回报。希望你无论选择做什么都做得好~

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
The future? I thought it was implied that any fortune I tell you is about the future in the specific field that you choose.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
未来？我以为暗示了我告诉你的任何运势都是关于你选择的具体领域的未来。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
I guess you want to know about the future in general. Let me commune with the spirits, and we'll see what they have to say, okay?
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
我想你想知道一般的未来。让我与灵魂沟通，看看他们怎么说，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Hmm...
In the future, Sex, Violence, and Rock and Roll are completely abolished. Mankind experiences an era of complete peace and utter boredom.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
嗯……
在未来，性、暴力和摇滚乐被完全废除。人类经历了一个完全和平和极度无聊的时代。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
In the future, Earth is protected by a single giant robot: Plutonium Overdrive Ignition Negatron G a.k.a POING.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
在未来，地球由一个巨大的机器人保护：钚过载点火负电子G，简称POING。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
In the future, believe it or not, the internet will be replaced by a giant brain. I don't know how, but trust me, this brain's huge.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
在未来，信不信由你，互联网将被一个巨大的大脑取代。我不知道怎么做，但相信我，这个大脑很大。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
In the future, they genetically engineer all sorts of plants.
So many kinds! It's crazy I tell you!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
在未来，他们对各种植物进行基因工程改造。
这么多品种！太疯狂了我告诉你！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
[Psychic Advisor]
Well...
That's my prediction. Can you really argue with the wisdom of the spirit world?
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
[灵媒顾问]
嗯……
那是我的预测。你真的能反驳灵界的智慧吗？

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
I don't know how far in the future that will occur, but it better not happen soon!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
我不知道那会在多远的未来发生，但最好不要很快发生！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
POING fights off many Kylorian invasions for years, until it is finally defeated by Dr. Hubris' Mechanical Overlord: Nyxltron 47.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
POING多年来击退了许多Kylorian入侵，直到最终被Hubris博士的机械霸主：Nyxltron 47击败。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Luckily, Doctor Pyeus finishes the Gravitron Oblivion Drive for the Plutonium Overdrive Ignition Negatron G system just in time.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
幸运的是，Pyeus博士及时完成了钚过载点火负电子G系统的引力湮灭驱动器。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
And so, POING rises again, reborn as the Automatic Hero: GOD-POING. Of course, Nyxltron 47 is destroyed.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
于是，POING再次崛起，重生为自动英雄：GOD-POING。当然，Nyxltron 47被摧毁了。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
That's probably the most important thing you'll ever learn about the future. Trust me, the rest of it's boring.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
这可能是你将来学到的最重要的事情。相信我，其余的都很无聊。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Thanks to the number of internet web journals, this brain becomes peaceful, and decides not to take over the world as it originally planned.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
由于互联网网络日志的数量，这个大脑变得平和，决定不按原计划接管世界。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Yes...
This weird brain thing definitely becomes a source for good, a loving benefactor to the human race, so long as people keep writing personal entries on the internet.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
是的……
这个奇怪的大脑事物绝对成为善良的源泉，人类的慈爱恩人，只要人们继续在互联网上写个人条目。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Eventually, they create trees that grow celebrity impersonators. Today, it looks like a miracle of science, and a threat to Hollywood starlets.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
最终，他们创造了生长名人模仿者的树。今天，它看起来像是科学的奇迹，也是对好莱坞明星的威胁。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
However, the people who buy these trees are the same kind who wear those really tacky shirts...
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
然而，购买这些树的人是同一种穿那些非常俗气衬衫的人……

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
You know, the kind with a lame sense of humor where it will have the word 'Cat-o-strophic' and there's this little kitten dressed like a mad scientist or something.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
你知道，那种幽默感很差劲的，上面写着‘Cat-o-strophic’，还有一只小猫打扮成疯狂科学家之类的。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Well...
That's my prediction. Can you really argue with the wisdom of the spirit world?
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
嗯……
那是我的预测。你真的能反驳灵界的智慧吗？

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Fashion...?
What does that have to do with matters of the supernatural? Well, um, let me contact the spirits. Ah! Here we go...
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
时尚……？
那和超自然事务有什么关系？嗯，嗯，让我联系灵魂。啊！来了……

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
...
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
...

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
It feels nice to wear expensive headgears! And it's nice to wear fancy clothing too! But remember...
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
戴昂贵的头饰感觉很好！穿华丽的衣服也很好！但记住……

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
I predict...
That Cowboy Hats will be very popular among female
Super Novices
very soon!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
我预测……
荒野之帽很快将在女性
超级初心者
中非常流行！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Sometimes, it's a cute idea to follow a theme. Like, if you wear both Angel Wing and Angel Wing Ears at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
有时，遵循主题是个可爱的主意。比如，如果你同时佩戴天使发圈和天使翅膀耳饰。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
I now predict that the Sombrero will be come very popular when a mass group of Bards form a guild in which the members only wear Sombreros.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
我现在预测，当一大群诗人组成一个成员只戴宽边帽的公会时，宽边帽将变得非常流行。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
[Psychic Advisor]
Well...
We psychic consultants aren't really trained for fashion matters, but I hope I was at least a little bit of help to you.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
[灵媒顾问]
嗯……
我们灵媒顾问并没有真正接受过时尚方面的训练，但我希望我至少对你有一点帮助。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
...
......

[Psychic Advisor]
I'm seeing something...
It looks like, a...
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
我看到了什么……
看起来像，一个……

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
A...
A... Fish?
On someone's head?
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
一个……
一个……鱼？
在某人头上？

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
...
It was the most horrible vision!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
...
那是最可怕的景象！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
No matter how much zeny you may put into your wardrobe, you'll look silly unless you match the things you wear.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
无论你在衣橱上投入多少泽尼，除非你搭配好穿的东西，否则你看起来很傻。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Now, here's a good example of a mismatched outfit. Imagine some Crusader wearing a Crown, Elven ears and an Iron Cain.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
现在，这是一个搭配不当服装的好例子。想象一下，一个十字军戴着皇冠、妖精长耳朵饰和金属口罩。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Instead of looking cool, they look sort of like an Evil Keebler Prince. Spooky, huh?
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
他们看起来并不酷，反而有点像邪恶的基布尔王子。 spooky，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Come on, wouldn't you agree? Cowboy Hats look great on Super Novices!
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
来吧，你不同意吗？荒野之帽戴在超级初心者身上很好看！

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Of course, that might be too expensive for most people, but you get the idea.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
当然，这对大多数人来说可能太贵了，但你懂我的意思。

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Or was it the Feathered Bonnet that's supposed to skyrocket in popularity? Both of those hats are just sooo stylish, especially on Bards...
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
或者是羽毛软帽预计人气飙升？这两顶帽子都非常时尚，尤其是戴在诗人身上……

scripts.text:
[Psychic Advisor]
Well...
We psychic consultants aren't really trained for fashion matters, but I hope I was at least a little bit of help to you.
scripts.translation:
[灵媒顾问]
嗯……
我们灵媒顾问并没有真正接受过时尚方面的训练，但我希望我至少对你有一点帮助。

scripts.text:
[Estheres]
Hello, I'm the resident expert of Monsterology here in Geffen. Is there anything in particular that you're curious about?
scripts.translation:
[艾丝特雷斯]
你好，我是吉芬当地的怪物学专家。你有什么特别好奇的吗？

scripts.text: Monsters in the Area.
scripts.translation: 区域内的魔物。

scripts.text: Recent Monster News.
scripts.translation: 最近的魔物新闻。

scripts.text: Era of Monsters
scripts.translation: 魔物时代

scripts.text: Jellopy Theory.
scripts.translation: 杰勒比结晶理论。

scripts.text:
[Estheres]
Well, as you may already know, since Wizards and Mages train in Geffen, monsters tend to stay away from the city. So tired adventurers are welcome to rest here.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝特雷斯]
嗯，正如你可能已经知道的，由于巫师和魔法师在吉芬训练，魔物往往远离城市。所以疲惫的冒险者欢迎在这里休息。

scripts.text:
[Estheres]
Still, if you want to seek out strong monsters, you can cross the bridge to the West and fight Kobolds.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝特雷斯]
不过，如果你想寻找强大的魔物，你可以穿过西边的桥与刺锤犬妖战斗。

scripts.text:
[Estheres]
You look strong enough for that kind of challenge. But if you see anyone more reckless cross the Western bridge, you might want to give them a warning.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝特雷斯]
你看起来足够强壮可以应对这种挑战。但如果你看到任何人更鲁莽地穿过西桥，你可能想给他们一个警告。

scripts.text:
[Estheres]
Um, but if you're planning to go there, you better not go alone. I really recommend that you be well prepared if you're gonna fight those kinds of monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝特雷斯]
嗯，但如果你打算去那里，最好不要单独去。如果你要对抗那种魔物，我真的建议你做好充分准备。

scripts.text:
[Estheres]
Recent news?
Well, the Juno Monster Museum is now open to the public. They have a fascinating exhibit and various monsters are now on display!
scripts.translation:
[艾丝特雷斯]
最近的新闻？
嗯，朱诺怪物博物馆现在向公众开放。他们有一个迷人的展览，各种魔物正在展出！

scripts.text:
[Estheres]
I mean, I've read about all sorts of monsters in the Prontera and Juno Libraries, and encountered a few in the wild, but now I get a chance to see some strong monsters in real life!
scripts.translation:
[艾丝特雷斯]
我的意思是，我在普隆德拉和朱诺图书馆读过各种魔物的资料，并在野外遇到过一些，但现在我有机会在现实生活中看到一些强大的魔物！

scripts.text:
[Estheres]
What's also exciting is the exploration achieved by you adventurers for the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝特雷斯]
同样令人兴奋的是你们冒险者为卢恩·米德加兹王国实现的探索。

scripts.text:
[Estheres]
When a new land is discovered, there are usually unique monsters that are indigenous to that area.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝特雷斯]
当发现新土地时，通常有该地区特有的独特魔物。

scripts.text:
[Estheres]
So new monsters are basically being discovered all the time! The variety of creatures that roam this world is really quite fascinating.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝特雷斯]
所以新魔物基本上一直在被发现！在这个世界上漫游的生物种类真的非常迷人。

scripts.text:
[Estheres]
The truth is that monsters have existed since ancient times. The Era of Monsters was when the power of the monsters was at its peak.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝特雷斯]
事实是，魔物自古以来就存在。魔物时代是魔物力量达到顶峰的时期。

scripts.text:
[Estheres]
They've plagued humans for a long time, but were completely annihilated in a great war between mankind and the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝特雷斯]
它们困扰人类很长时间，但在人类与魔物之间的一场大战中被彻底消灭。

scripts.text:
[Estheres]
However, as the balance of nature has changed, the monsters have inevitably returned. Not too many people know this, but most monsters were gentle creatures at one time. It's sad, really...
scripts.translation:
[艾丝特雷斯]
然而，随着自然平衡的变化，魔物不可避免地回来了。没有多少人知道这一点，但大多数魔物曾经都是温和的生物。真可悲……

scripts.text:
[Estheres]
Ah yes, Jellopy.
It seems that almost every monster around is composed of Jellopy. But is it just a crystallization made by some monsters, or is it... More?
scripts.translation:
[艾丝特雷斯]
啊是的，杰勒比结晶。
似乎周围的几乎每个魔物都由杰勒比结晶组成。但它只是某些魔物产生的结晶，还是……更多？

scripts.text:
[Estheres]
From our research of ancient monsters and studies of recently discovered monsters, it seems that that traces of Jellopy cannot be found in stronger beasts.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝特雷斯]
从我们对古代魔物的研究和最近发现的魔物的研究来看，似乎在更强的野兽中找不到杰勒比结晶的痕迹。

scripts.text:
[Estheres]
Still, may of us believe that there might be some relation to Jellopy and monsters, although it may be hard to believe that there is any.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝特雷斯]
不过，我们许多人相信杰勒比结晶和魔物之间可能存在某种关系，尽管很难相信有任何关系。

scripts.text:
[Estheres]
It's possible that Jellopy may be linked to a monster's personality and strength. So, if you mixed Jellopy with something, you'd create a stronger monster.
scripts.translation:
[艾丝特雷斯]
杰勒比结晶可能与魔物的个性和力量有关。所以，如果你将杰勒比结晶与某物混合，你会创造出更强大的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Estheres]
Of course, doing that kind of experimentation just seems dangerous. You might be able to unleash some really scary monsters into the world...
scripts.translation:
[艾丝特雷斯]
当然，做那种实验似乎很危险。你可能会向世界释放一些真正可怕的魔物……

scripts.text:
[Citizen]
There was a skillful weapon smith
in Al De Baran who had 4 sons.
Unfortunately he lost all of his sons
while developing a powerful weapon.
The father survived alone from the tragedy.
scripts.translation:
[市民]
艾尔帕兰有一位技艺高超的武器工匠，他有4个儿子。
不幸的是，他在开发一种强大武器时失去了所有儿子。
父亲独自从悲剧中幸存下来。

scripts.text:
[Citizen]
How sad it will be for the father...
Because of the incident, the weapon smith
retired from his work and hid himself somewhere.
After that, no one could ever see
the powerful weapon that he and his sons were developing.
scripts.translation:
[市民]
对父亲来说多么悲伤……
由于那次事件，武器工匠
退休并藏身某处。
从那以后，再也没有人见过
他和他的儿子们正在开发的强大武器。

scripts.text:
[Citizen]
I don't think that 4 sons of him
went to the heaven with the anxiety.
scripts.translation:
[市民]
我想他的4个儿子
带着焦虑去了天堂。
